title: Waymo cars stranded on San Francisco streets as Fourth of July gridlock drains batteries

reading.body:
Waymo autonomous vehicles were deployed into severe traffic congestion during Fourth of July celebrations in San Francisco, where at least a dozen vehicles ran out of battery power and required towing. The vehicles were primarily Jaguar I-PACE models. This shows a system used outside the conditions it was built for, since autonomous vehicles designed for normal traffic patterns were sent into gridlock that the company itself characterized as caused by major disruptions, high volume, and unexpected road closures.

A separate vehicle caught fire after driving over fireworks ignited on the street, while a passenger reported the car continued driving despite the hazard nearby. This indicates the system lacked either detection of or response capability for obstacles and dangers created by unusual event conditions. Human monitoring or routing decisions could have prevented both the battery depletion and the exposure to hazardous road debris.

It is not established whether Waymo actively directed vehicles into this congestion or whether drivers summoned vehicles without knowing conditions had changed, nor is it established what the vehicle's design parameters specified about acceptable traffic density or battery reserve requirements.

reports.title: Waymo cars stranded on San Francisco streets as Fourth of July gridlock drains batteries

summary:
Several Waymo autonomous vehicles ran out of battery power and required towing during severe traffic congestion in San Francisco following Fourth of July fireworks celebrations on Saturday. Video footage showed at least a dozen stationary Waymo vehicles, primarily Jaguar I-PACE models, lined up on city streets. The company attributed the gridlock to major traffic disruptions, high traveler volume, and unexpected road closures. Additionally, one Waymo vehicle caught fire after driving over fireworks that someone had ignited on the street, though no injuries were reported. A passenger described witnessing the autonomous car continue driving while fireworks exploded nearby.

The incident prompted frustration from stranded motorists, with some drivers spending nearly two hours in traffic. San Francisco Mayor Daniel Lurie's office announced plans to meet with stakeholders about the situation to improve traffic management for future large events. This incident follows a previous December incident when Waymo vehicles stopped at broken traffic lights during a citywide power outage affecting over 100,000 customers. The company stated it is evaluating ways to strengthen its resilience during major traffic disruptions.
